nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Starter README for the page-neural Vue 3 + TypeScript + Vite package, pointing to Vue script-setup and TypeScript project-setup docs.

nodes.name: index.html
nodes.summary: Vite HTML shell for the page-neural package that mounts #app and loads src/main.ts as the module entry.
nodes.languageNotes: Standard Vite index.html with a module script pointing at /src/main.ts.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: Private ESM workspace package @gritty-lots/page-neural that exports src/index.ts and runs Vue 3 with Vue Flow, ant-design-vue, and Vite build scripts.
nodes.languageNotes: Package is type module; main/module/types/exports all point at ./src/index.ts. vue and vue-i18n are both dependencies and peerDependencies.

nodes.name: tsconfig.app.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript config for page-neural Vue/TS sources, extending the Vue DOM tsconfig with Vite client types and unused-symbol linting.
nodes.languageNotes: Extends @vue/tsconfig/tsconfig.dom.json; includes src/**/*.ts, src/**/*.tsx, and src/**/*.vue with allowArbitraryExtensions.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: Solution-style TypeScript project that references the app and Node/Vite configs without compiling any files itself.

nodes.name: tsconfig.node.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript config for the page-neural Vite config file using NodeNext modules, noEmit, and unused-symbol linting.
nodes.languageNotes: module nodenext with allowImportingTsExtensions and verbatimModuleSyntax; include is vite.config.ts only.
